paragraphs.text: Svyelun is the goddess of the Pearl moon , which is also a name given to Svyelun herself. She is patron to Dominaria 's early merfolk empire of Vodalia .

Ancient Vodalians depicted Svyelun as a sky-dwelling merfolk. The symbol of Svyelun is the "winged moon" – a full moon ringed by a gleaming halo, with a bright pair of circular spots on opposites of the halo. The Society of the Conch of the Svyash caste, travels the world to seek a closer understanding of Svyelun by contemplating the ways she manifests in other cultures.

It was said that Svyelun had created the merfolk out of silt and seawater. She was and is a remote figure; she handed down her teachings in ancient times and has not communicated with mortals since then. Her words from that time are recorded in ancient writings that are the focus of Svyelunite theology.

Early Vodalians worshiped Svyelun as the goddess of the Pearl Moon, though she later she became a more abstract figure. One of the key tenets of Svyelunism is that mortals cannot approach the divine: the moon is above the sea, above the lethal desert of the land, above even the sky, and no mere merfolk can hope to reach it. Circular mirrors, placed horizontally and facing upward, mimicking the surface of the water, mark places of worship. Every twenty-eight days, when the Mist Moon reaches its full phase, devotees of the goddess are obligated to spend the night in ritual contemplation.
